name: AI bird feeder camera
summary: A seed tray with a perch and a weatherproof box for a Raspberry Pi 4 and the Raspberry Pi AI Camera, which names every bird that lands, on one USB-C supply.

spec.name: AI Bird Feeder Camera
spec.function: Photographs and identifies the birds at a feeder: birds land on a printed perch in front of a seed tray, the Raspberry Pi AI Camera in a closed box behind the tray runs a bird classifier on its IMX500 sensor, and the Raspberry Pi 4 saves the picture with the species and posts it over Wi-Fi, all from one USB-C supply.
spec.quote: Build me a bird feeder with a camera that tells me which birds visit, like the BirdBrain feeder on Hackster but with the Raspberry Pi AI Camera so the Pi doesn't have to do the AI: seed tray, a perch, a closed box for the Pi with a lens window, under 150 euros and 900 grams. A blackbird landing on the perch shouldn't bend it more than a millimetre, the box mustn't get hotter than 60 degrees inside on a 30 degree day, the supply needs 1.5 times what the Pi peaks at, and it can't tip over on the ledge.

parts.name: Seed tray
parts.description: Open tray 220 x 160 mm centred on X=Y=0 (Z 0 to 18) with 2.4 mm walls, a 3 mm floor and ten 4 mm drain holes in the front half where the seed lies.

parts.name: Perch
parts.description: Bar 10 x 8 mm spanning 170 mm between two 38 mm posts along the tray front (Y -90 to -80), with tabs over the tray lip.

parts.name: Camera box
parts.description: Closed box 110 x 70 x 60 mm on the back of the tray floor (X -55 to 55, Y 10 to 80, Z 3 to 63) with 2.4 mm walls, an 18 mm lens window in the front wall at Z 45, 360 mm2 of vent slots high in the side walls and a USB-C cable hole in the back.

parts.name: Roof
parts.description: Lid 130 x 90 x 3 mm on the camera box (Z 63 to 66) that overhangs the window and the vents, with a rim that locates it on the box walls.

parts.name: Single-board computer
parts.description: Reads the labels from the camera, saves the pictures and posts them

parts.name: AI camera
parts.description: Behind the lens window, runs the bird classifier on the sensor

parts.name: Bird seed, full tray
parts.description: About 300 g of sunflower seed in the front half of the tray

requirements.text: Perch bends at most 1 mm under a landing blackbird (2 N)
requirements.quote: A blackbird landing on the perch shouldn't bend it more than a millimetre

requirements.text: Inside the camera box stays under 60 °C on a 30 °C day
requirements.quote: the box mustn't get hotter than 60 degrees inside on a 30 degree day

requirements.text: Supply gives 1.5 times the peak current
requirements.quote: the supply needs 1.5 times what the Pi peaks at

requirements.text: Tips only beyond 20 degrees with a full tray
requirements.quote: it can't tip over on the ledge

pi.reason: The AI Camera does the classifying, so the cheapest Pi with a camera port and Wi-Fi is enough; the Pi Zero 2 W and Pi 5 are out of stock at Berrybase today.

camera.reason: The IMX500 runs the bird model on the sensor and hands the Pi only the labels; it ships with the camera cable.

power.reason: The official 15.3 W Pi 4 supply: 3 A for a 1.5 A peak.
